title: Defence #2 · 4 fighter jets of the Indian Air Force (Tejas, Mirage 2000, Su-30MKI, Rafale)

captions.instagram:
4 fighter jets of the Indian Air Force, and how to spot each one ✈️

1 Tejas: a small triangle wing with a kink. Designed and built in India.
2 Mirage 2000: a triangle wing with a straight edge. From France, upgraded by HAL.
3 Su-30MKI: two tail fins. Russian design, built by HAL.
4 Rafale: small front wings (canards) and one tail fin. With the IAF since 2020.

Which one would you want to fly? Comment its number 👇

Flying one starts with the written exam: maths is 300 of the 900 marks.

Our own models, not to scale.
